requirements.title: Six technical electives with open eligibility
requirements.summary: Choose six technical electives. Any 300- or 400-level COMP_SCI course is also eligible. The displayed additional list is not the complete universe of this open category.

requirements.title: Second-major relationship
requirements.summary: This is an additional major for non-McCormick students, not a standalone degree. The University Registration Requirement and the home school’s degree requirements remain applicable.

requirements.title: Eleven unique AI units
requirements.summary: The college explicitly applies an 11-unit uniqueness minimum to both McCormick and non-McCormick AI second majors: these units cannot also meet another major, minor or certificate.

requirements.title: Home-school grade and transfer boundary
requirements.summary: The college’s 11-unique-unit statement expressly covers non-McCormick second majors. Its separate 22-unit McCormick GPA/transfer wording is not silently assigned to this 19-unit program; home-school rules are mapped conditionally, with unresolved applicability conflicts recorded separately.

requirements.title: Quarter units and repeated credit
requirements.summary: Traditional Evanston undergraduate work uses quarters and published course units. Exceptions carry different unit amounts; no individual credit is inferred from a program total. All repeated attempts stay in the GPA, but a nonrepeatable course earns credit only once, for the highest-grade attempt.

requirements.title: Advanced course entry
requirements.summary: 400-level electives may require permission for advanced undergraduates. Inclusion in the eligible technical category does not waive course prerequisites or registration permission.

requirements.title: University P/N boundary
requirements.summary: Only CAESAR Student Option courses permit elected P/N. The student’s school policy controls application to requirements; general availability is not AI-major permission.

requirements.title: Incomplete coursework
requirements.summary: An incomplete must be resolved by the following like term or an earlier agreed deadline, and before graduation; unresolved work converts to F. Grades cannot be changed after conferral.

requirements.title: Resident registration, distinct from an extra degree
requirements.summary: A single-degree first-year entrant needs nine Northwestern quarters and 32 Northwestern units; a transfer entrant needs six and 21. An additional major is not itself a dual degree. Approved cross-school dual-degree programs have different eleven/42 and transfer nine/32 thresholds.

requirements.title: Registration versus earned credits
requirements.summary: A counted quarter needs at least two Northwestern units under Northwestern faculty; earned-credit and registered-quarter tests differ, and NR is excluded. Qualifying Northwestern-faculty -SA study-abroad work may count; ordinary external transfer does not. Rare waiver petitions require advising and documented grounds, with quarter reductions limited to University error.

requirements.title: McCormick P/N application and unresolved AI permission
requirements.summary: For McCormick students, Student Option availability and the program’s approval are both needed. The public page limits eight P courses and uses the Friday-of-week-eight deadline; years one/two permit one P/N course per quarter. The catalog separately says eight units. The linked dated table has no AI row, so neither universal AI permission nor a CS-major prohibition is inferred.

requirements.title: External graded-credit P/N exception
requirements.summary: An external course taken for a letter grade but posted without one may be exempted from McCormick P/N restrictions through an approved curriculum petition.

requirements.title: McCormick equivalence approval and version discrepancy
requirements.summary: McCormick transfer credit lacking a direct equivalent needs a curriculum petition outside unrestricted electives. At most four major transfer units need departmental approval and possibly tighter department limits. This operational page still describes a 21-unit major; the current AI catalog specifies 22, so the older amount is not substituted.

requirements.title: Weinberg-student grade and overlap conditions
requirements.summary: For Weinberg students, major and related courses need C− or better and cannot remain P. A prior P requires adviser consultation. Majors/minors normally total at most three, with advising permission for exceptions. The AI catalog’s more specific program-versus-related-course overlap rules and eleven unique AI units also apply.

requirements.title: Weinberg transfer-student major residence
requirements.summary: Weinberg transfer students must complete four 300-level major courses at Northwestern, or all such required courses if the major has fewer than four. Further study away must be planned with advising; this is not a rule for students in other home schools.

requirements.title: SoC grade and overlap conditions
requirements.summary: For SoC students, P or D cannot satisfy major, minor or distribution requirements; they may serve electives. SoC allows overlap with non-SoC programs subject to the other program’s restrictions, including eleven unique AI units.

requirements.title: SoC eligibility statement conflicts with AI route
requirements.summary: The SoC catalog says its students cannot take an Engineering second major, while the current AI and McCormick catalogs expressly describe a non-McCormick AI route. Whether the new AI route is an exception for SoC students requires reconciliation; this record does not promise eligibility.

requirements.title: Music-student overlap and P/N context
requirements.summary: Music courses may overlap non-music programs only as permitted by that program. Bienen permits at most six non-music P/N courses toward its degree; this does not itself establish AI-major P/N eligibility.

requirements.title: Bienen eligibility statement conflicts with AI route
requirements.summary: Bienen’s general double-major wording requires enrollment in the other home school for its majors, whereas the specific AI catalog advertises a non-McCormick route. The AI exception’s applicability to music students remains unresolved.

requirements.title: Medill-student grade and P/N context
requirements.summary: Medill students need a 2.0 GPA in nonjournalism letter-graded work. Its general P/N limit is three courses and one per quarter; specified categories, including WCAS concentration courses, require letters. That WCAS wording is not treated as an explicit AI-program P/N permission or prohibition.

requirements.title: SESP-student overlap, grades and transfer
requirements.summary: SESP permits P/N only for electives, one unit per quarter. Up to three concentration units may overlap a second or adjunct major, while required Weinberg related courses are exempt from that limit. AI’s eleven unique units still apply. External coursework needs advance approval, and SESP requires B or better for community-college credit.

requirements.title: Post-matriculation transfer approval
requirements.summary: Consult school/major advisers and submit a proposal with course description or syllabus before outside coursework; a month of lead time is recommended. Review proceeds through home school, relevant department and applicable credential adviser, then student and final school approval. Final official transcript is required; advance approval does not guarantee final articulation. McCormick may accept two-year/community-college credit with approval.

requirements.title: Mathematics transfer format restriction
requirements.summary: Mathematics post-matriculation transfer courses must be in person at a fully accredited four-year institution; online coursework is not accepted by the department.

requirements.title: Study-abroad credit approval
requirements.summary: Follow the approved study-abroad process before foreign coursework, including the published home-country exceptions. After program evaluation and official transcript review, eligible credit is initially general elective credit; school petition is needed to designate a Northwestern course or apply it to major/minor requirements. Program-specific conversion ratios apply; no universal conversion is inferred.

requirements.title: Reviewed PDF scope
requirements.summary: The linked McCormick P/N table is dated January 22, 2018 and has no AI departmental row. Its Computer Science rule is not silently applied to the separately cataloged AI major.

requirements.title: Reviewed PDF scope
requirements.summary: The linked 2025–2026 table addresses non-WCAS students completing WCAS majors/minors. It is not direct authority for overlap with a McCormick AI second major; current source applicability remains distinct.

requirements.title: Duplicate courses are not substitutions
requirements.summary: Only one of duplicate courses may satisfy a McCormick degree/certificate requirement; taking a duplicate does not replace a specifically required course and cannot supply an unrestricted elective. CS110/111 duplication is conditional on taking111 first; CS230/211 on taking211 first. The observed duplicate-set groups below retain the published pairs, bundles and conditions.
